agents.name: Claude Code

surface_source.quote: I originally tried to use claude code normally, by iteratively prompting in the terminal until I get the output I want.

agents.quote: With the spec document in hand, I turned over to Claude code for actual implementation work.

models.name: Claude 3.7 Sonnet
models.quote: alias q "llm -s \"Answer in as few words as possible. Use a brief style with short replies.\" -m claude-3.7-sonnet";

review_style.value: Owns the structure, runs the code, does not vet the guts
review_style.quote: I want to be careful — I can’t vouch for correctness and especially completeness of the above snippet. However, given that the nature of the problem is such that I can just run the code and see the result, I am fine with it.

also.quote: This is how this overall vibe-coding session transpired — I was providing structure, Claude was painting by the numbers.
After claude finishes iterating on a step you look at the diff and interactively prompt for necessary corrections.

harness.value: ChatGPT expands a rough idea into SPEC.md, Claude Code implements against hand-typed skeletons
harness.quote: Then I asked ChatGPT to expand those two paragraphs into a more or less complete spec to hand down to an agent for implementation.

history.value: plan.md task list, one step per conversation, then a mutable spec.md
history.quote: When I want to apply a change to terminal-editor now, I prompt claude to update the spec first (unchecking any items that need re-doing), manually review/touch-up the spec, and use a canned prompt to align the code and tests with the spec.

rules_files.value: plan.md task list the prompt points Claude at (no CLAUDE.md)
rules_files.quote: Read @plan.md, complete the next task, and mark it with X.

signature.caption: Claude fills in the bodies
signature.why: Our pick: he types the types and function signatures himself and has Claude complete only the bodies, so the code keeps his structure.
signature.quote: The hand-written skeleton/vibe-coded guts worked not only for the CLI.

archetype.why: Writes the structure by hand and lets Claude fill in only the parts he calls trivia.

signature_quote.value: I was providing structure, Claude was painting by the numbers.
